text:
alyssa: Quick ask — need a one-slide benchmark narrative for next Wednesday's launch. Focus: show tradeoffs across Hosted / Dedicated / Private for a 512-token chat workload. Two short narrative hooks + one visual choice. Anyone take? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devin: I can draft. Proposal 1: 'Speed-first: how choice of deployment maps to latency tail and cost' — visual = 2x2 chart (latency percentile vs $/1k tokens) with colored bands per deployment. Short bullet copy.

rita: +1 — also suggest a compact 'operational levers' inset that lists batching, quantization, caching and routing with arrows to cost/latency.

sam: For visuals I'd recommend a small multiples layout: three mini line charts (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) showing p50/p95 as function of concurrency. Easier for PMs to scan.

alyssa: Love the small multiples idea. Can you mock the axes labels and example numbers? We want to emphasize that Dedicated gives predictable p95 while Hosted can be cheaper at low QPS.

devin: mock data snippet:
```
concurrency: [1,5,10,50]
hosted_p95_ms: [120,150,300,800]
dedicated_p95_ms: [110,120,140,200]
private_p95_ms: [130,135,150,180]
cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: [0.20, 0.15, 0.18] # hosted,dedicated,private
```

sam: Copy hooks (two options):
1) "Choose speed or scale without surprise — Redwood matches your latency to your budget."
2) "Maximize performance per dollar — predictable tails, predictable spend."

rita: For inbound routing, recommend two CTAs on the slide: 'Try hosted — free credits' (self-serve) and 'Talk to sales — dedicated sizing'. Drive click-to-demo and 'capacity consult'.

alyssa: Need an owner for the slide and a small script for webinar. Devin/Maria can own. Maria? @maria are you free to polish the copy and align with deck tone?

maria: I can do copy + 30s webinar script. Will finish by EOD tomorrow. Suggest using phrase "predictable tail latency" rather than "p95" in consumer-facing slides.

devin: I'll sketch the small multiples PNG today. Want the CSV for visuals — Rita, can you confirm the numbers above or adjust?

rita: I'll sanity-check and add one line for caching on/off. Minor tweak to hosted cost to 0.18.

marketing-bot: Reminder: content freeze for launch assets is 48h before publish — calendar notice sent.

alyssa: Great. Outcome: Devin mock, Maria copy/script, Rita data sanity check. Deliver by 24 hours. Thanks team :rocket:
